question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

Abundant
solution:
The correct answer is: **Meagre**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abundant **means plentiful or a lot of something. (विपुल)

 
 
• **Example**: *Her talent for gardening led to an abundant harvest of fruits and vegetables.*
 
 
 
• **Meagre **is the opposite of abundant, meaning not enough or very little of something. (अल्प)
 
 
• **Example**: *The meagre income made it challenging for them to make ends meet.*
 
 
 
• Other possible antonyms of abundant could be scarce, insufficient, or inadequate.
 
• In this context, we are looking for the word that means the opposite of abundant, which is meagre.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Unconscious **means not awake or aware. (बेहोश)
 
• **Indefinite **means not clear or precise. (अनिश्चितकालीन)
 
• **Unreliable **means not dependable or trustworthy. (अविश्वसनीय)
